mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO "user" ( email , password_hash , name , nickname , phone_num , position , status , is_admin)
VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{phoneNum}, #{position}, #{status}, #{isAdmin})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM "user" WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.nickname, u.phone_num AS phoneNum, COALESCE(u.position, '') AS position, COALESCE(u.status, 'ACTIVE') AS status, u.is_admin AS isAdmin, u.report_reason_code AS reportReasonCode, rr.display_name AS reportReasonDisplayName, rr.description AS reportReasonDescription, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN report_reason rr ON u.report_reason_code = rr.code WHERE 1=1 AND u.id = #{id}
